# Canonical v1.0.1 helper

`v1.0.1-apply.sh` is the exact helper generated by `install_apply_script` in
`gre4.sh` at commit `1d4ed3ca890a44b1e997fc520626c38566d6eaee`, with the installer's
canonical default paths. It was extracted once from the repository's Git object
and generated without calling `main`; tests do not download or regenerate it.
Its SHA-256 is
`682ae45f5424789d582d393ee691213e01603301b86f4b26110720d67d349e63`.

The workflow test first copies these exact bytes into its private executable
path and calls production `legacy_verify_helper` with the production digest.
Before any execution, it maps deployment, recovery, sysctl-file and UFW paths
(including UFW's otherwise hard-coded read paths) into a private temporary
directory. All writes stay there; the helper retains its read-only `/proc`
checks. This
necessarily changes the hash, so only the subsequent offline migration uses
the mapped copy's hash. Both old and new runtime helper bodies execute against
the same filesystem-backed network/sysctl/systemd substitutes. These tests do
not establish real GRE traffic, systemd boot behavior, or live UFW persistence.
